Rights-cleared video and audio datasets

India and Southeast Asia cultural context datasets
Speech, scene and object-interaction data

similarOrganizations.name: The ePlane Company
similarOrganizations.description:
The ePlane Company is redefining urban air mobility with the e200X, India's first electric air ambulance and taxi. Engineered around a compact 8 by 10 meter footprint , it utilizes existing city helipads and rooftops instead of requiring entirely new infrastructure. As a deep-tech "Make in India" breakthrough, its core subsystems—including the propellers, airframe, landing gear, and battery packs are developed entirely indigenously.

Current Stage & Capital
Backed by $21 million in total funding, including a $14 million Series B , and 7 years of subscale validation, ePlane has transitioned from simulation to hardware. Full-scale assembly of the first prototype, PT-01, is complete, integrating all core subsystems into a single physical structure. PT-01 is entering ground testing at IIT Madras to validate structural loads , moving directly into flight testing and DGCA Type Certification. Notably, ePlane holds India's first Design Organisation Approval (DOA) for a private electric aircraft.

Leadership & Credibility
Incubated at IIT Madras and founded by Prof. Satya Chakravarthy , the company pairs top-tier aerospace expertise with capital-efficient engineering. Its deep-tech capability is validated globally, recently featured in NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang's GTC Keynote and selected for the government's flagship Bharat Innovates 2026 showcase in France, inaugurated by Prime Minister Narendra Modi and President Emmanuel Macron.

The Future
The commercial rollout leads with the air ambulance to address the critical emergency "golden hour" , cutting urban transit times from hours to minutes. This same scalable airframe will later expand to serve passenger air taxi and urban cargo sectors , redefining city transit as a formal public unveil approaches in the coming weeks.

similarOrganizations.name: datasutram.ai
similarOrganizations.description:
Data Sutram is an Enterprise AI-Trust Platform helping India's financial institutions solve fraud, risk, collections, and portfolio challenges across the customer lifecycle. It operates as a new-age intelligence bureau unifying fragmented data signals into a single, actionable view of every customer, from acquisition through portfolio monitoring to collections.

The platform runs on two layers. Auth, the intelligence layer, delivers external intelligence that tells institutions who to trust millions of signals spanning Trust, Identity, Employment, Vehicle, Financial, Business, and Traceability dimensions. This enables sharper decisioning without relying solely on bureau data, achieving 35–40% fraud capture at under 3% false positives, and 16–37% gains in contactability on delinquent portfolios.

Echo, the agentic layer, acts on that intelligence — 100+ AI workflows turning insight into action: calls, outreach, verification, recovery. Its speech engine covers 20+ languages at 95%+ accuracy and sub-100ms latency, already running live bots in Hindi and English for EMI reminders, promise-to-pay conversion, and customer verification.

"Auth to know, Echo to act" addresses four shifts in BFSI: rising fraud from mules and organized networks, the strain of scaling collections, new-to-credit customers outside traditional scoring, and digital-first expectations for instant experiences.

Data Sutram is not a credit bureau, point solution, or data reseller — it augments bureau data, spans the full lifecycle, and delivers proprietary intelligence and outcomes rather than reselling raw data.

The platform serves 50+ financial institutions and is fully compliant with ISO 27001, ISO 27018, SOC 2, and India's DPDP Act, built on tokenized flows with no raw PII persistence. It's backed by investors including Lightspeed Ventures and B Capital, with three Forbes 30 Under 30 founders.

Smartomica is an AI‑enabled clinical IT platform developed around a proprietary methodology for complex patient assessment and personalized care delivery. Built by a multidisciplinary team of physicians, data scientists, and healthtech entrepreneurs, Smartomica addresses a critical unmet need in modern clinical practice.
✔The Challenge
Physicians today manage vast, fragmented data - clinical notes, labs, imaging, genomics - scattered across non-integrated systems. What they need is not more data, but structured, clinically relevant insights to support medical reasoning.
✔The Solution
Smartomica transforms disorganized data into a coherent clinical picture, enabling faster orientation, greater diagnostic confidence, and individualized care- especially in complex or ambiguous cases.
✔Clinical Foundation
The platform is built on a reproducible clinical framework, developed from real-world experience with over 100 advanced, chronic, and multifactorial cases. This methodology was embedded into a fully functional EMR and enhanced by a proprietary AI logic engine designed to emulate physician thought processes—absorbing diverse inputs, generating hypotheses, and adapting with feedback.
✔Clinically Inspired AI Engine
Smartomica does not merely automate tasks—it interprets data in clinical context, supports diagnostic hypotheses, and evolves with use. It mirrors how doctors think and work, improving clarity, speed, and decision-making.
✔Robust IT Infrastructure
Smartomica offers an enterprise-grade, modular system integrating EMR, CRM, diagnostics, and operations. Fully cloud-native, privacy-compliant, and interoperable (HL7, FHIR), it enables seamless deployment in solo or multi-site clinics.
✔What Sets Us Apart
Smartomica is grounded in clinical logic, not just technical design. It supports real diagnostic workflows, complements clinical judgment, and thrives in domains requiring personalization - oncology, longevity, women’s health.

name: Helium
tagline: Gated Homes. 1-month deposit.
description:
After chasing multiple brokers and navigating fake listings, you finally found the perfect apartment.
Gated society. Great layout. Right budget.

You call the broker.
“It’s already rented.”
Or worse: “The owner wants 10 months’ deposit.”

Why does finding a good home feel like chasing ghosts?
Because renting in India still runs on a broken system — one built on power, not partnership. 
The very word “landlord” comes from feudal times, when owning land meant absolute control — and tenants had little say. And somehow, decades later, good tenants are still treated like risks, not responsible people.

At Helium, we’re flipping that dynamic.

We handpick good homeowners and bring them to one trusted platform — so good tenants get the experience they deserve. Tenants get only real and available listings, visits that work around their schedule, and 1-month security deposit. All of this while homeowners get qualified tenants, guaranteed rent, and the peace of mind that their home is finally being taken care of.

This isn’t just a better product.
Its a better ecosystem.

Zomato’s mission statement is “better food for more people.” Since our inception in 2010, we have grown tremendously, both in scope and scale - and emerged as India’s most trusted brand during the pandemic, along with being one of the largest hyperlocal delivery networks in the country.

We’re innovating hard to make last-mile delivery carbon neutral, to eliminate the use of plastic packaging, create meaningful opportunities in the gig economy, and to feed our country’s ever-growing appetite for high-quality, affordable, and hygienic food, one delivery at a time!

Akshayakalpa is India’s first certified organic dairy enterprise bringing together a balance of practices based in science and the traditional heritage of dairy farming. At Akshayakalpa, sustainability is not a choice, it is a way of life. Our farmer-first, planet-friendly approach ensures every product that goes from our lush farms to your fridge is rich in nutrition, free antibiotics, chemicals and preservatives.

At the heart of our eco-system is our community of farmers. Our farmer entrepreneurship initiatives empower them by providing the resources required to emulate a business model that is not only profitable but humane, honest and above all, ethical.

We believe in conforming to standards of what is good and right. At Akshayakalpa, this begins at the grass-root level - literally! Organic fodder grown on our farms is the source of nourishment for our cows. No chemicals or hormones are added to their diet and thus do not find their way into the produce. Our cows are free-roaming and stress-free, which positively impacts the quality of the milk and it is high in nutrition and taste.

We are part of an on-going journey to create sustainable dairy farms which are a perfect amalgamation of our goal to nurture nature, preserve traditional practices and our scientific expertise. Akshayakalpa Organic milk is the main ingredient for all our products and it is here that we begin our assurance of quality and taste. Our milk is untouched by human hands, cooled via scientifically designed techniques and packaged with utmost care. This ensures zero-contamination and a high quality of product – both of which are tested regularly at our facility.
Our Farm Fresh Milk and A2 Milk are used in our other organic dairy products like curd, ghee, butter, paneer and artisan cheese under the Akshayakalpa brand. Each of these products bear the stamp of sustainability, nutrition and great taste – everything Akshayakalpa stands for!

similarOrganizations.name: Association of Professional Career Counsellors of India
similarOrganizations.description:
The Association of Professional Career Counsellors of India (APCCI) is a Non-profit organization headquartered at New Delhi, India registered under Section 8 of the Companies Act 2013, dedicated to supporting career counsellors across the country. What started as a humble WhatsApp group called "Career Launch Gurus" has grown into a recognised National Platform for Career counselling Professionals in just two years, thanks to the dedication and enthusiasm of its members.

Back then, it was a simple space where a handful of counsellors exchanged ideas, shared knowledge, and supported each other. As the group expanded, so did the desire for a more structured and inclusive community where counsellors could connect, learn, and grow together. With this collective spirit, APCCI was born, establishing a platform that values ethics, learning, and professional growth.

Today, APCCI offers its members valuable services such as professional development through training and certification, networking opportunities through events, and access to the latest research and insights in career counselling. It also advocates for the profession and sets ethical and professional standards to help elevate the counselling industry in India.

Despite its growth, APCCI stays true to its roots — it remains a democratic community driven by counsellors, for counsellors. Every member is part of this evolving journey, contributing to making career counselling more professional, impactful, and accessible nationwide. If you're a career counsellor looking for a community that supports your growth and strengthens your professional practice, APCCI welcomes you with open arms. Join us NOW to be part of this inspiring journey.

The institute has a mandate of advancing basic virology, medical countermeasures and pandemic preparedness for viral diseases of public health importance. It is a WHO Collaborating Centre for emerging infectious diseases, and a global leader in Virology. NIV reported the country’s first detection of key pathogens such as KFD virus, CCHF virus, Nipah virus and Zika virus, enabling rapid outbreak response. From a modest beginning with a handful of members in 1956, AMA now boasts around 400 institutional members and over 3000 individual members. These members converge on this platform to exchange ideas, information, and experiences, thereby enriching their managerial skills and competence.

similarOrganizations.name: Roadstar Infra Investment Trust
similarOrganizations.description:
Incorporation of the Roadstar infra investment Trust was a thoughtful financial restructuring, outlined by the New Board appointed by the Union of India for the resolution of the IL&FS Group's debt. The initiative aimed to resolve outstanding debt and balance the interests of diverse stakeholders, maximizing value in a fair and orderly manner according to a Resolution Framework approved by the National Company Law Appellate Tribunal.

This approach isn't solely about resolving debt. It’s a strategic initiative notably designed to benefit stakeholders by creating an avenue for creditors to recover their exposure to IL&FS Group Entities. Simultaneously, it establishes a protective barrier around the road projects operated by the Trust SPVs. The transfer of ownership interests in these SPVs to a diverse pool of investors—encompassing banks, non-banking financial companies, mutual funds, provident funds, and insurance companies—strengthens the sustainability and resilience of these projects.

Roadstar infra investment, in essence, becomes a vehicle for value enhancement, offering a structured and efficient framework for resolving lender exposure while safeguarding the assets held within the Trust SPVs. Moreover, the broad spectrum of investors involved augurs well for stability, diversification, and sustained growth within the infrastructure investment landscape.

ICMR’s 28 National Institutes address themselves to research on specific health topics like tuberculosis, leprosy, cholera and diarrhoeal diseases, viral diseases including AIDS, malaria, kala-azar, vector control, nutrition, food & drug toxicology, reproduction, immuno-haematology, oncology, medical statistics, etc. Its 6 Regional Medical Research Centres address themselves to regional health problems, and also aim to strengthen or generate research capabilities in different geographic areas of the country


The Council's research priorities coincide with National health priorities such as control and management of communicable diseases, fertility control, maternal and child health, control of nutritional disorders, developing alternative strategies for health care delivery, containment within safety limits of environmental and occupational health problems; research on major non-communicable diseases like cancer, cardiovascular diseases, blindness, diabetes and other metabolic and haematological disorders; mental health research and drug research (including traditional remedies). These efforts are undertaken with a view to reduce the total burden of disease and to promote health and well-being of the population.

This handle is a broadcast channel only; responses are not monitored. For queries, use the website or email at icmrhqds@sansad.nic.in

The ePlane Company is redefining urban air mobility with the e200X, India's first electric air ambulance and taxi. Engineered around a compact 8 by 10 meter footprint , it utilizes existing city helipads and rooftops instead of requiring entirely new infrastructure. The Future
The commercial rollout leads with the air ambulance to address the critical emergency "golden hour" , cutting urban transit times from hours to minutes. This same scalable airframe will later expand to serve passenger air taxi and urban cargo sectors , redefining city transit as a formal public unveil approaches in the coming weeks.

The official page of Wildlife Trust of India (WTI), a non-profit conservation organisation, committed to urgent action that works towards the protection of India's wildlife. Its mission is to conserve nature, especially endangered species and threatened habitats, in partnership with communities and governments.

Established in November 1998, in response to the rapidly deteriorating condition of the country's wildlife, with only three staff members, WTI now has a team of over 200 full-time professionals and consultants, in addition to volunteers from all walks of life.

The core team includes scientists, field biologists, conservation managers, veterinarians, lawyers, finance, business management and communication specialists, who operate diverse conservation projects across India.  In 25+ years, WTI has grown to be one of India's premier wildlife NGOs.

The principal concerns of WTI include crisis management and the provision of quick, efficient aid to individuals, species or habitats that require it the most. In its 25+ years of operations, WTI has saved more than 54,334 animal lives, trained and equipped 20,076 frontline forest staff and covered them under India's pioneering supplementary accident assurance scheme that also covers COVID-19, assisted the govt. in creating 7 Protected Areas, sensitised more than 30 lakh children to conservation, protected almost 1,77,664 hectares of natural habitat including mangroves and coral reefs, and assisted enforcement agencies in almost 302 enforcement operations to dismantle wildlife trade and trafficking. 

WTI is a registered charity in India (under Section 12A of the Income Tax Act, 1961) and is mandated by its Board of Trustees to ensure that 85% of all specified donor monies go to the field for direct conservation action.

Lokta is the agentic loan servicing platform for the live loan book, built on a deterministic loan management system (LMS) core. We build for banks, NBFCs, fintechs, digital lenders, and lending service providers (LSPs) running loan books in India and other emerging markets.

The cost of servicing a loan book should not scale with the book. For most lenders it does. Risk teams ship one policy change a quarter, and collections react only after a payment is missed. Every new tranche of accounts still needs more people to serve it.

Bring your loan book and your servicing and collections policy. Lokta agents run the work after you approve it: loan servicing, monitoring and early warning, collections, and recovery. They act inside your guardrails, with autonomy you can audit.

AI proposes. The deterministic core decides. The record proves it. An agent can draft a hardship plan, flag an account sliding toward delinquency, or test a collections strategy. It never posts to the ledger directly. The deterministic core does that, and every action lands on the audit record.

Every repayment and recovery feeds a richer borrower model. Agents test hundreds of collection and servicing strategies in the time a risk team ships one. Winners get promoted inside the policy bounds you set, with the evidence for each one on the record. The book sharpens itself the more it lends.

The number that matters is profit per loan disbursed.

We built the rails the lending industry already runs on. Lokta comes from the team behind Apache Fineract, the open source loan management core used by lenders in 70+ countries, an ecosystem credited with an estimated $500B+ in loans to 65M+ borrowers. We also built and scaled a commercial lending platform on those foundations. Lokta is agent-native from the ground up: the loan servicing and collections platform we would build if we started today.

If the cost of running your loan book has grown faster than the book itself, that's the conversation to have.

We are parents just like you. Our journey began when we, Ghazal and Varun, were expecting our first child. That’s when we decided to do something about it & create products which were completely safe & certified toxin free. A brand, by a parent, for the parent. We are not a fund. We have no exit clock. We measure in decades.

Our first operating company is Hanulytics, an AI-native trading analytics platform for India's retail futures and options market: the largest derivatives market in the world by contract volume. India's ongoing regulatory reforms are professionalizing retail participation, and Hanulytics exists to give individual traders the analytical infrastructure that institutions have had for decades. It is led by our founding team spanning derivatives trading, quantitative research, and AI engineering.

Hanulytics is the first proof of the Ceryneian model: identify the dislocation, build the operator team, hold for the long term. The companies that follow will be built the same way.

Ceryneian Partners is headquartered in Los Angeles, US, with operations spanning the United States and India.

MoneyThumb is the data and fraud intelligence platform that funders, lenders, and embedded finance platforms trust to convert financial documents into decision-ready intelligence with the accuracy, fraud detection, and defensibility that the SMB funding market demands.

PDF Insights converts bank statements and financial documents into a decision-ready underwriting scorecard in under five seconds, flagging negative balance days, true revenue, low balance patterns and other key indicators before a human ever touches the file.
 
ThumbPrint®, our patented fraud detection system, catches document tampering before it becomes an issue. Using a database built across thousands of financial institutions, ThumbPrint creates a unique fingerprint for each institution and runs two verification passes on every document, checking for internal inconsistencies like mismatched fonts, column irregularities, and date formatting, then comparing the document against that institution's known fingerprint. The result is an authenticity score from 1 to 1,000 delivered in under five seconds, with a clear explanation of exactly why a document was flagged.

That's when selling globally stops being a business challenge and becomes a payments challenge.

PayGlocal was built for that moment.

As an RBI-authorized cross-border payments platform, we help businesses accept international payments, collect funds in multiple currencies, and navigate the complexities of global commerce through intelligent payment infrastructure built for scale.

Because when payments work the way they should, businesses are free to focus on what they do best: building products, serving customers, and growing beyond borders.

Global commerce isn't powered by a single product. It's powered by an ecosystem that makes every payment faster, smarter, and more reliable. PayGlocal brings together domestic and cross-border payment acceptance, multi-currency collections, payment orchestration, fraud and risk intelligence, and AI-driven optimization into one unified platform, helping businesses grow without borders.
